# Pull-request quality gates

Before proposing or opening a pull request, read the repository-root `AGENTS.md` and complete all four canonical gate skills. Their checklists and required report formats are authoritative; this file does not duplicate them.

- `.agents/skills/ai-slop/SKILL.md`
- `.agents/skills/ponytail/SKILL.md`
- `.agents/skills/over-engineering/SKILL.md`
- `.agents/skills/framework-patterns/SKILL.md`

Fix findings and rerun affected gates. Include all four gate reports in the PR. Never claim a gate or test passed unless it was actually run/reviewed.
